p14-how-we-check: Every badge tells you who said so, and when.
We never just copy a list. Strongest first:
Their front desk confirmed it in the last 14 days.
At least 3 patients said it worked in the last 30 days, and more said yes than no.
Only the NHIA or insurer list says so. Call first.
3 or more patients were turned away since the hospital last confirmed, and more were turned away than served. This beats any list.
Under 24 hours: shown normally. 1 to 3 days: marked "may have changed". Older: greyed out until the hospital checks in.
Counts always say if they cover the last 7 days, the last 30 days or the last 12 months. We keep the history. Reports we hold back or reject are kept, but never counted.
Hospitals can't pay to change a badge. Paid partners get tools and reports, never a better rating.

p13-help: No smartphone? No data? Dial Veriq.
Works on any phone, any network. The answer comes back by SMS so you can keep it.

2) LAKESIDE FAMILY CLINIC, Dansoman 2.6km. NHIS: 14 patients confirmed in the last 30 days.
Dial again and choose 3 to report a refusal.
